signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the strategy, performance, and day-to-day operations of the data product, ensuring it delivers meaningful value to customers and supports broader business objectives.
Lead product discovery and delivery for complex features, including customer discovery sessions, requirements gathering, PRD development, and coordination with engineering.
Use AI and technical investigation techniques to explore the codebase, answer functionality questions, and accelerate product discovery and decision-making.
Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and provide recommendations based on customer needs, technical considerations, and business priorities.
Partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to plan releases, manage dependencies, coordinate launches, and ensure successful feature rollouts.
